'''Mariyk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked in the [[Drunkard's Vote]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Senate Commercial District]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Her cantina was a favorite haunt for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] during the war.
